subject: TTFT & streaming requirements - follow-up (FinApp)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Harris <alex.harris@finapp.co>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: TTFT & streaming requirements - follow-up (FinApp)

Hi Alex / Samir —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the time. Quick written recap from our discovery so we’re aligned before the tech deep-dive. Please flag anything I missed.

Call highlights / FinApp targets:
- User-facing chat (primary): Time-to-first-token (TTFT) target: <= 100ms; ideal target for premium flow: 50–80ms.
- Streaming: prefer an SSE endpoint for web clients, but mobile apps may use WebSocket. Chunk cadence goal: 150–300ms per chunk (aim for 200ms median).
- Throughput & concurrency: baseline concurrency target: 50 concurrent sessions; peak bursts up to ~100 concurrent. Sustained throughput target: ~150–200 req/s for peak hours.
- Model/context: prefer ~16k token context models for session history.
- Observability/SLAs: need latency breakdowns (TTFT, token delta), per-request tracing, and audit logs for request ids.

Next steps we proposed on the call:
1) Tech deep-dive with our infra engineer (Vivek) and your platform lead — propose 60m deep-dive to cover protocol (SSE vs WS), chunking cadence, and perf harness.
2) Redwood to provide a small perf harness + sample streaming clients (SSE + WebSocket) for FinApp to validate in your staging environment.
3) Share an initial SLA/TTFT matrix and recommended config (batching / kv-cache / model variant) for experimental runs.

My ask: can you confirm the TTFT and chunk cadence targets above, and confirm who from your infra team should join the deep-dive? If helpful, we can run a short pilot (50k tokens) to validate TTFT on your region.

Attachments: I’ll follow up with the SLA matrix and sample code after you confirm.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Alex Harris <alex.harris@finapp.co>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@finapp.co>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TTFT & streaming requirements - follow-up (FinApp)

Thanks Marissa — this looks right. A couple clarifications from our side:

- TTFT: we need first-byte TTFT to be at or under 80ms for the primary chat experience (this is a hard product requirement for our paid tier). 100ms is acceptable for lower-priority flows.
- Chunk cadence: we prefer ~200ms median cadence. Important: on mobile we occasionally see network jitter; we’ll want the client to tolerate variable chunk sizes but keep the server-side cadence target.
- Protocol preference: WebSocket is our preference for mobile (persistent connection), SSE is fine for browser fallback. We’ll want sample clients for both.
- Concurrency/throughput: sustained target ~150 rps but expect bursts up to 250 rps for short windows during promo events. Concurrent sessions estimate: 50 steady, burst to 100–150.
- Context size: 16k tokens for session history; some regression tests will include 32k contexts — curious how TTFT changes at that context length.

Additional asks:
- Can you include SOC 2 / security evidence in the next packet (we’ll need that for procurement)?
- Can you propose a mutual action plan (timeline + responsibilities) in the deep-dive?

We can do the tech deep-dive tomorrow at 11am PT if that works for Vivek and Rishi. I’ll have our platform lead Samir on the call.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Harris
Head of Platform Engineering, FinApp
alex.harris@finapp.co | +1 (206) 555-0133

Hi Alex — thanks for the quick clarifications, that helps.

Confirmed items: TTFT hard target set to 80ms for primary paid-tier flow; 200ms median chunk cadence; WebSocket preferred for mobile, SSE fallback for web. We’ll plan to validate both protocols in the perf runs. We’ll also include explicit tests at 16k and 32k context lengths so you can see delta on TTFT.

Action plan / next steps:
- I’ll get a 60m deep-dive on the calendar for tomorrow 11am PT (Vivek and Rishi will join).
- Redwood will share: (1) a short SLA/TTFT matrix (attached), (2) sample streaming clients (SSE + WebSocket) and a perf harness for staging, and (3) SOC2 evidence bundle for procurement.
- Pilot proposal: run a 2–3 hour pilot in your staging that hits 150–250 rps in short bursts and records TTFT at 16k/32k contexts. We’ll provide scripts and expected dashboards.

Attachments: redwood-ttft-sla-matrix.pdf, redwood-streaming-sample-code.zip
Related links: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/FinApp/TTFT-eval | https://hubspot.com/deal/1142

If that all looks good I’ll send the calendar invite and drop the sample artifacts into the shared drive.

Best,
Marissa
